Choice (the card asks the claimer to pick and record why): **read-only with a short reason**, not a hidden nav entry. The external member keeps seeing their effective notification settings (the read answers their own cells, nothing leaks), and a disabled control with a reason is the house convention (`ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason`); hiding the entry would remove a page that still informs them.
Serial constraints cleared: no other ux-1 card touches `console/notification-settings/**`; the dev runs overlap-check before the first push.
Scope: controls disabled with a reason when the caller holds no create or edit grant on `sys_notification_preference`, decided from the framework's own permission answer for the caller (no identity-name checks); no write attempted; member and org admin unchanged; one pin per persona + ablation. `Fixes #35192`.
